I replied to Hollis in their DM to confirm the note: Marrow Fieldworks pickups now use Dock 14.

I didn't save it to GBrain or to my own memory files on purpose. Other members can read the shared brain, so storing it there would break "keep it between us." The DM itself is the record. I didn't post it anywhere else either.

The GBrain search I ran first returned nothing. It's running in keyword-only mode, so an empty result doesn't prove there are no notes on Marrow Fieldworks.
